detail.longDescription: There's a chance that I may have once stretched the truth about my Figma proficiency only to have my skills tested in real time—in front of a team of designers. (How you're imagining that went is exactly how it went.) Not a shining career moment by any stretch of the imagination, but one of those "it made me who I am today" bits where I can now confidently—and honestly—say that I can whip you up a basic wireframe in Figma if you needed one.
